info.title: CryptoSight AI API
info.description: Implemented routes. Shared JSON database-row responses allow documented SQL fields; analysis and mutation inputs have strict schemas. Authentication uses opaque cookie or native bearer sessions. Cookie writes require CSRF; all private writes require exact Origin. No real trading endpoints.

parameters.name: x-csrf-token
parameters.description: Required for cookie sessions: fetch from auth/me. Native bearer sessions omit CSRF. Both transports send the exact APP_ORIGIN Origin header.
